## Standards check

> Run `bash .elev8/sync.sh` first. Cite the standard, never paste it.
> Tick only what you actually checked. `n/a` is a fine answer — an unticked box is not.

- [ ] **No generic content.** Every page is specific to this client — their calls, reviews,
      operations, clinicians. Nothing here would read identically on a competitor's site.
      → `standards/content-specificity.md`
- [ ] **Nothing published that must not be.** No cash-pay rates, bed counts, availability,
      payer specifics, headcount, or unverifiable claims. → `standards/what-not-to-publish.md`
- [ ] **YMYL / clinical review.** Clinical claims are accurate and attributed to a real,
      credentialled reviewer who has actually signed off.
      → `standards/ymyl-principles.md`, `standards/medical-clinical-review.md`
- [ ] **PHI.** No PHI reaches analytics, tag manager, session recording or any third party.
      → `standards/phi-data-handling.md`
- [ ] **SEO requirements** met for every page type touched.
      → `standards/seo-page-requirements.md`, `standards/page-types.md`
- [ ] **Schema** correct for these page types. → `standards/schema.md`
- [ ] **Redirects** — every destination exists in the build. No chains, no loops.
      → `standards/redirects-migrations.md`
- [ ] **No standard was copied into this repo**, and no standard was worked around.
